name: Play Integrity & Pairip
author: ELFTrace
description: Detects Google Play Integrity API and Pairip (AIP) native markers. Pairip indicates native VM code protection; the API alone only attests app/environment integrity.

rules.name: AIP / Pairip native marker
rules.description: Google Automatic Integrity Protection (Pairip) native VM / core library (libpairipcore.so). NOT the developer Play Integrity API (com.google.android.play.core.integrity).

rules.name: Play Integrity API namespace
rules.description: Play Integrity API library namespace present in the native blob (embedded DEX/path reference).

rules.name: Play Integrity Classic hint (nonce)
rules.description: Classic request hint: setNonce() reference. Static hint only — obfuscation can hide it.

rules.name: Play Integrity Standard hint (requestHash)
rules.description: Standard request hint: requestHash reference. Static hint only — obfuscation can hide it.

rules.name: StandardIntegrityManager
rules.description: Standard request path class reference (likely Standard). Static hint only.

rules.name: IntegrityManager (classic)
rules.description: Classic request path method reference (likely Classic). Static hint only.
